import ExtractedVerifyPrefixModel
import ExtractedTx1Reachability

/-! Actual tx1 acceptance reaches the same public helper and begin call through
complete emitted verify_observed. Its post-begin tail and the independent tx1
view/allocation/arithmetic/query APIs remain explicit universal boundaries. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.VerifyPrefix

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

private theorem pair_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok p => cases p with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- No helper-success premise: actual successful verifier prefix supplies it. -/
theorem verify_success (F : Finish) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (bytes : Slice U8) (hash : H) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (out : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (h : verify F D pub bytes hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ pre initial after challenges,
      PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted bytes = ok (.Ok pre) ∧
      r1_semantic.public_transcript D pub hash pre.c1_root = ok (.Ok initial) ∧
      r1_wire.begin D pre initial = ok (.Ok challenges, after) ∧
      F D pub pre after challenges obs = ok (.Ok out) := by
  unfold verify at h
  obtain ⟨pr, hp, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases pr with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases h
  | Ok pre =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok, mark] at h
    obtain ⟨tr, ht, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases tr with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok initial =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨cr, after, hb, h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
      cases cr with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
        cases h
      | Ok challenges =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok, mark] at h
        exact ⟨pre, initial, after, challenges, hp, ht, hb, h⟩

/-- Fixes the actual tx1 verify boundary to the complete checked prefix. The
supplied public value is carried unchanged to the actual public helper. -/
theorem tx1_helper_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (F : Finish) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (publicBytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 { B with verify := verify F } P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs =
      ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ view sem pre initial after challenges,
      B.view proof = ok (.Ok view) ∧
      verify F D pub view.semantic hash obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted view.semantic = ok (.Ok pre) ∧
      r1_semantic.public_transcript D pub hash pre.c1_root = ok (.Ok initial) ∧
      r1_wire.begin D pre initial = ok (.Ok challenges, after) ∧
      F D pub pre after challenges obs = ok (.Ok sem) := by
  obtain ⟨_, view, sem, prepared, acc, g, hv, _, hs, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    Tx1Reachability.tx1_success { B with verify := verify F } P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs out h
  obtain ⟨pre, initial, after, challenges, hp, ht, hb, hf⟩ :=
    verify_success F D pub view.semantic hash obs sem hs
  exact ⟨view, sem, pre, initial, after, challenges, hv, hs, hp, ht, hb, hf⟩

#print axioms verify_success
#print axioms tx1_helper_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.VerifyPrefix

      "old_source": "#[inline(never)]\npub fn tx1<H:Digest32>(public:Public<'_>,public_bytes:&[u8],proof:&[u8],k:usize,hash:H,obs:Observer)->Result<Vec<u8>,Error> {\n    if k>22 {return Err(Error::Parse);}\n    let v=View::parse(proof)?;mark(obs,Phase::Parsed);\n    let sem=crate::r1_semantic::verify_observed(public,v.semantic,hash,obs).map_err(|_|Error::Semantic)?;mark(obs,Phase::Semantic);\n    let p=Prepared::new(&sem,&v,hash)?;let mut a=Accumulator::new(v.variant)?;let g=powers::<29>(p.gamma);mark(obs,Phase::Prepare);\n    tx1_finish(v,p,a,g,public_bytes,proof,k,hash,obs)\n}",

import ExtractedVerifyPrefixReachability
import ExtractedFirstCallerReachability

/-! Full emitted first → actual tx1 → actual verify prefix → actual helper.
The first SDK observer/error interpretation and post-begin/tx1 tail boundaries
remain explicit; no child success, decoder result, public equality or serializer
success is assumed. Custody and completed transcript agreement are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstHelperBinding

/-- The exact constructor-by-constructor nominal observer carrier transport. -/
def phaseToFirst : verifier.Phase → FirstCaller.Phase
  | .Parsed => .Parsed
  | .Semantic => .Semantic
  | .SemanticPart i => .SemanticPart i
  | .Prepare => .Prepare
  | .CheckpointRead => .CheckpointRead
  | .Merkle i => .Merkle i
  | .Query i => .Query i
  | .QueryPart i j => .QueryPart i j
  | .CheckpointWrite => .CheckpointWrite
  | .Relation => .Relation
  | .Final => .Final

def tx1 (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (F : VerifyPrefix.Finish) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Unit)
    (pub : FirstCaller.Public) (asf8 proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : Unit)
    (obs : Option (FirstCaller.Phase → Result Unit)) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) verifier.Error) :=
  Tx1Model.tx1 { B with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F } P D pub asf8 proof k hash
    (obs.map (fun mark => fun phase => mark (phaseToFirst phase)))

/-- Actual caller acceptance supplies hd, equality of supplied and decoded
public, the helper's serializer success hs, and the matching parsePublic result. -/
theorem first_helper_parsePublic {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (F : VerifyPrefix.Finish) (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Unit)
    (mark : FirstCaller.Phase → Result Unit) (error : verifier.Error → Result E)
    (asf8 proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : FirstCaller.first invalidAccountData (tx1 B P F D) mark error asf8 proof k =
      ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ s supplied view sem pre initial after challenges bytes wire,
      AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
        asf8 = ok (.Ok s) ∧
      supplied = PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s ∧
      B.view proof = ok (.Ok view) ∧
      PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted view.semantic = ok (.Ok pre) ∧
      r1_semantic.public_transcript D supplied () pre.c1_root = ok (.Ok initial) ∧
      r1_wire.begin D pre initial = ok (.Ok challenges, after) ∧
      F D supplied pre after challenges
        (some (fun phase => mark (phaseToFirst phase))) = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
        (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok bytes) ∧
      AspisR1.PublicSourceRaw.toWire (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.projectRaw s) = some wire ∧
      AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (bytes.val.map AspisR1PublicSerializer.RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) ∧
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.new D () (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes) pre.c1_root =
        ok (.Ok initial) := by
  obtain ⟨s, supplied, hd, heq, ht⟩ := FirstCaller.first_success invalidAccountData
    (tx1 B P F D) mark error asf8 proof k out h
  change Tx1Model.tx1 { B with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F } P D supplied asf8 proof k ()
    (some (fun phase => mark (phaseToFirst phase))) = ok (.Ok out) at ht
  obtain ⟨view, sem, pre, initial, after, challenges, hv, _, hp, hh, hb, hf⟩ :=
    VerifyPrefix.tx1_helper_success B P F D supplied asf8 proof k ()
      (some (fun phase => mark (phaseToFirst phase))) out ht
  have hh' : r1_semantic.public_transcript D (PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s) () pre.c1_root =
      ok (.Ok initial) := heq ▸ hh
  obtain ⟨bytes, wire, hs, hw, hparse, hn⟩ := PreparationBinding.decoder_helper_parsePublic
    D asf8 s () pre.c1_root initial hd hh'
  exact ⟨s, supplied, view, sem, pre, initial, after, challenges, bytes, wire,
    hd, heq, hv, hp, hh, hb, hf, hs, hw, hparse, hn⟩

#print axioms tx1
#print axioms first_helper_parsePublic
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstHelperBinding

/-- Actual outlined helper success returns precisely the claims owned by the
same actual Verified witness used by Prepared::new. Box lifetime is audited in
Rust separately; this is the generated Box-erased value boundary. -/
theorem prepare_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public) (v : verifier.View)
    (hash : H) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (claims : Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize)
    (prepared : verifier.Prepared)
    (h : Tx1Model.prepare B P D pub v hash obs = ok (.Ok (claims,prepared))) :
    ∃ sem,
      B.verify D pub v.semantic hash obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Semantic = ok () ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem v hash = ok (.Ok prepared) ∧
      claims = sem.claims := by
  unfold Tx1Model.prepare at h
  obtain ⟨semResult, hs, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases semResult with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, Tx1Model.semanticErrorClosure,
      Tx1Model.semanticError, bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
    cases h
  | Ok sem =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hm, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases u
    obtain ⟨prepResult, hp, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases prepResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok p =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
      have heq := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
      have hc : sem.claims = claims := congrArg Prod.fst heq
      have hp' : p = prepared := congrArg Prod.snd heq
      subst p
      exact ⟨sem, hs, hm, hp, hc.symm⟩

theorem tx1_call_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)

    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 B P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :

      B.view proof = ok (.Ok v) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Parsed = ok () ∧
      Tx1Model.prepare B P D pub v hash obs = ok (.Ok (claims,prepared)) ∧
      Tx1Model.newAccumulator B v.variant = ok (.Ok acc) ∧
      B.powers 29#usize prepared.gamma = ok g ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Prepare = ok () ∧
      B.finish D v prepared acc g publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out) := by

      obtain ⟨u, hm, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases u

      cases prepareResult with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,

theorem tx1_ownership_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (publicBytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H)

    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 B P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :

      Tx1Model.mark obs .Parsed = ok () ∧
      Tx1Model.prepare B P D pub v hash obs = ok (.Ok (claims,prepared)) ∧
      B.verify D pub v.semantic hash obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Semantic = ok () ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem v hash = ok (.Ok prepared) ∧

import ExtractedTx1Model

/-! Success inversion of the complete emitted approved tx1 body. Actual
observer dispatch, allocation constructor and error closures are retained;
View.parse, verify_observed, heap allocation, powers and query/checkpoint tail
remain explicit function parameters. No helper reachability inside verify,
full25 hread, downstream arithmetic, SDK or custody theorem is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1Reachability

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Exact initialized result follows from actual constructor success, without
assuming allocation success or accepting any staging panic definition. -/
theorem accumulator_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (v : transport.Variant)
    (out : verifier.Accumulator)
    (h : Tx1Model.newAccumulator B v = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ n weights,
      Tx1Model.final_len v = ok n ∧
      B.filled Tx1Model.copyInst n aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO = ok (.Ok weights) ∧
      out = ⟨weights, aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO, Tx1Model.one, 0#usize⟩ := by
  unfold Tx1Model.newAccumulator at h
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases r with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, Tx1Model.allocationErrorClosure,
      Tx1Model.allocationError, bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
    cases h
  | Ok weights =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, bind_tc_ok,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at h
    exact ⟨n, weights, hn, hr, (core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)).symm⟩


/-- Actual outlined helper success returns precisely the claims owned by the
same actual Verified witness used by Prepared::new. Box lifetime is audited in
Rust separately; this is the generated Box-erased value boundary. -/
theorem prepare_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public) (v : verifier.View)
    (hash : H) (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (claims : Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize)
    (prepared : verifier.Prepared)
    (h : Tx1Model.prepare B P D pub v hash obs = ok (.Ok (claims,prepared))) :
    ∃ sem,
      B.verify D pub v.semantic hash obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Semantic = ok () ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem v hash = ok (.Ok prepared) ∧
      claims = sem.claims := by
  unfold Tx1Model.prepare at h
  obtain ⟨semResult, hs, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases semResult with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, Tx1Model.semanticErrorClosure,
      Tx1Model.semanticError, bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
    cases h
  | Ok sem =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      bind_tc_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hm, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases u
    obtain ⟨prepResult, hp, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases prepResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok p =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
      have heq := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
      have hc : sem.claims = claims := congrArg Prod.fst heq
      have hp' : p = prepared := congrArg Prod.snd heq
      subst p
      exact ⟨sem, hs, hm, hp, hc.symm⟩

theorem tx1_call_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (publicBytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 B P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    k.val ≤ 22 ∧ ∃ v claims prepared acc g,
      B.view proof = ok (.Ok v) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Parsed = ok () ∧
      Tx1Model.prepare B P D pub v hash obs = ok (.Ok (claims,prepared)) ∧
      Tx1Model.newAccumulator B v.variant = ok (.Ok acc) ∧
      B.powers 29#usize prepared.gamma = ok g ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Prepare = ok () ∧
      B.finish D v prepared acc g publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out) := by
  unfold Tx1Model.tx1 at h

  · cases h
  · rename_i hk
    have hbound : k.val ≤ 22 := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨viewResult, hv, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases viewResult with
    | Err e =>

        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok v =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨u, hm, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases u
      obtain ⟨prepareResult, hp, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h

/-- Actual current helper/caller success, with the existing verification API
fixed to the checked complete verify prefix. All children are reached from
acceptance, and returned claims belong to that same semantic result. -/
theorem tx1_prefix_ownership (T : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (F : VerifyPrefix.Finish) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (publicBytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 {T with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F} P D pub
      publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ view sem claims prepared pre initial after challenges,
      T.view proof = ok (.Ok view) ∧
      Tx1Model.prepare {T with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F} P D pub view hash obs =
        ok (.Ok (claims,prepared)) ∧
      claims = sem.claims ∧
      PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted view.semantic = ok (.Ok pre) ∧
      r1_semantic.public_transcript D pub hash pre.c1_root = ok (.Ok initial) ∧
      r1_wire.begin D pre initial = ok (.Ok challenges,after) ∧
      F D pub pre after challenges obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem view hash = ok (.Ok prepared) := by
  obtain ⟨_,view,sem,claims,prepared,acc,g,hv,_,hp,hs,_,hprep,hclaims,_,_,_,_⟩ :=
    Tx1Reachability.tx1_ownership_success {T with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F} P D
      pub publicBytes proof k hash obs out h
  obtain ⟨pre,initial,after,challenges,hparse,hh,hb,hf⟩ :=
    VerifyPrefix.verify_success F D pub view.semantic hash obs sem hs
  exact ⟨view,sem,claims,prepared,pre,initial,after,challenges,hv,hp,hclaims,hparse,hh,hb,hf,hprep⟩

/-- Decoder/selector are actual checked definitions. The supplied public value,
actual semantic/public-transcript call and helper-returned claims share one
first-body success witness; no child success or claims choice is assumed. -/
theorem first_ownership {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (T : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries) (F : VerifyPrefix.Finish)
    (D : aspis_core.Digest32 Unit) (mark : FirstCaller.Phase → Result Unit)
    (error : verifier.Error → Result E) (asf8 proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : FirstCaller.first invalidAccountData (FirstHelperBinding.tx1 T P F D)
      mark error asf8 proof k = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ s supplied view sem claims prepared pre initial after challenges,
      AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
        asf8 = ok (.Ok s) ∧
      supplied = PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s ∧
      T.view proof = ok (.Ok view) ∧
      Tx1Model.prepare {T with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F} P D supplied view ()
        (some (fun phase => mark (FirstHelperBinding.phaseToFirst phase))) =
        ok (.Ok (claims,prepared)) ∧
      claims = sem.claims ∧
      PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted view.semantic = ok (.Ok pre) ∧
      r1_semantic.public_transcript D supplied () pre.c1_root = ok (.Ok initial) ∧
      r1_wire.begin D pre initial = ok (.Ok challenges,after) ∧
      F D supplied pre after challenges
        (some (fun phase => mark (FirstHelperBinding.phaseToFirst phase))) = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem view () = ok (.Ok prepared) := by
  obtain ⟨s,supplied,hd,heq,ht⟩ := FirstCaller.first_success invalidAccountData
    (FirstHelperBinding.tx1 T P F D) mark error asf8 proof k out h
  change Tx1Model.tx1 {T with verify := VerifyPrefix.verify F} P D supplied asf8 proof k ()
    (some (fun phase => mark (FirstHelperBinding.phaseToFirst phase))) = ok (.Ok out) at ht
  obtain ⟨view,sem,claims,prepared,pre,initial,after,challenges,hv,hp,hclaims,hparse,hh,hb,hf,hprep⟩ :=
    tx1_prefix_ownership T P F D supplied asf8 proof k ()
      (some (fun phase => mark (FirstHelperBinding.phaseToFirst phase))) out ht
  exact ⟨s,supplied,view,sem,claims,prepared,pre,initial,after,challenges,
    hd,heq,hv,hp,hclaims,hparse,hh,hb,hf,hprep⟩

#print axioms tx1_prefix_ownership
#print axioms first_ownership
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1PrepareContracts
